sloka: वसिष्ठो भरतश्चैनं पप्रच्छतुरनामयम् ।शरीरे ऽग्निषु वृक्षेषु शिष्येषु मृगपक्षिषु ॥ २.९०.८
transliteration: vasiṣṭho bharataścainaṁ papracchaturanāmayam ।śarīre 'gniṣu vṛkṣeṣu śiṣyeṣu mṛgapakṣiṣu ॥ 2.90.8

translations.english: Vasistha and Bharata also enquired about his health and welfare of his sacred fires, his disciples, animals and birds and trees of the hermitage.
